final: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), product_shares AS (SELECT *, CAST(order_item_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(order_item_count) OVER (), 0) AS order_item_share FROM product_stats), type_averages AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM product_shares GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count, AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS average_share FROM type_averages
